propositions: Four criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) have produced zero findings across ~7,900 agentic executions, motivating a deterministic pre-filter.
A conservative DetGateRule pre-gate sits in front of the unchanged ADR-0034 LLM router and skips a criterion only when its subject vocabulary is entirely absent from the plan.
A rule fires if all text_all regexes match the plan text, OR any file_impact path matches a glob, OR the file_impact_reason_re matches an entry's reason or path.
T13/T14 extend the overlay _DET_OVERLAY_RULES path while removal-rationale and asserted-capability use a parallel leaf-gate table with a second gate block in route_criteria.
Skipped criteria are recorded via a gate_log threaded through all route_criteria callers and surfaced in the sidecar under coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id.
The migrated existing overlay entries T5a/T5d/T7/T12 must fire identically to their prior regex strings, and asserted-capability fires only when both text_all legs match.
